# Allowlist for .github/scripts/check-security-guide-refs.py
#
# One token per line, `#` starts a comment. A token here is skipped when
# verifying that every code reference in SECURITY_GUIDE.md resolves in the tree.
#
# Add a token only when the reference is correct but genuinely unresolvable:
# an external crate's API, a name that only exists in generated code, or prose
# that happens to match an identifier pattern. Always give the reason on the
# line, so the next person can tell a deliberate exception from an accident.
#
# Do NOT use this to silence a reference that broke because code moved. That is
# the drift the check exists to catch: update the guide instead.

# Exported metric name. The instrument is declared as
# `surrealdb.statement.mutable_permission_writes`
# (observe/instruments.rs::names::STATEMENT_MUTABLE_PERMISSION_WRITES); the
# Prometheus exporter replaces the dots and appends the counter suffix, so the
# name an operator queries exists only after export. The guide names the queried
# form because that is what a reviewer checking the capability's usage signal
# needs, and it matches doc/OBSERVABILITY.md.
surrealdb_statement_mutable_permission_writes_total
